mapper.insert: INSERT INTO business_outbox(kind, aggregate_id, user_id, state, next_attempt_at) VALUES (#{kind}, #{aggregateId}, #{userId}, 'PENDING', NOW(3))
INSERT INTO business_outbox( kind, aggregate_id, user_id, state, next_attempt_at, deliver_at ) VALUES (#{kind}, #{aggregateId}, #{userId}, 'PENDING', #{deliverAt}, #{deliverAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM business_outbox WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM business_outbox WHERE (state = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= NOW(3)) OR (state = 'SENDING' AND lease_until < NOW(3)) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE business_outbox SET state = 'SENDING', lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{seconds} SECOND) WHERE id = #{id} AND ((state = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= NOW(3)) OR (state = 'SENDING' AND lease_until < NOW(3)))

UPDATE business_outbox SET state = 'DONE', consumed_at = NOW(3), sent_at = CASE WHEN #{markSent} AND sent_at IS NULL THEN NOW(3) ELSE sent_at END, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND state <> 'DONE'
UPDATE business_outbox SET state = 'DONE', consumed_at = NOW(3), lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND state <> 'DONE'
UPDATE business_outbox SET state = 'PENDING', next_attempt_at = deliver_at, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'SENDING' AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}
UPDATE business_outbox SET state = 'REVIEW', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND state <> 'DONE'
UPDATE business_outbox SET state = 'PENDING', next_attempt_at = NOW(3), lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE state = 'SENT' AND sent_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{ageSeconds} SECOND)

UPDATE business_outbox SET state = 'PENDING', next_attempt_at = NOW(3), lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE state = 'PENDING' AND attempts > 0 AND next_attempt_at <= NOW(3) AND next_attempt_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{ageSeconds} SECOND)

UPDATE business_outbox SET state = 'PENDING', attempts = 0, consume_attempts = 0, next_attempt_at = NOW(3), sent_at = NULL, consumed_at = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'REVIEW'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM business_outbox WHERE state = #{state}
SELECT * FROM business_outbox WHERE kind = 'CAMPAIGN_FULFILL' AND aggregate_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE business_outbox SET state = 'PENDING', attempts = 0, consume_attempts = 0, next_attempt_at = NOW(3), sent_at = NULL, consumed_at = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE kind = 'CAMPAIGN_FULFILL' AND aggregate_id = #{orderId} AND state = 'REVIEW'

UPDATE business_outbox SET state = 'PENDING', attempts = 0, consume_attempts = 0, next_attempt_at = NOW(3), deliver_at = NULL, sent_at = NULL, consumed_at = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE kind = 'CAMPAIGN_FULFILL' AND aggregate_id = #{orderId}
UPDATE business_outbox SET state = 'DONE', consumed_at = NOW(3), lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE kind = 'CAMPAIGN_FULFILL' AND aggregate_id = #{orderId} AND state <> 'DONE'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM business_outbox o JOIN campaign_reservation r ON r.order_id = o.aggregate_id WHERE r.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND o.kind IN ('CAMPAIGN_FULFILL','CAMPAIGN_STOCK_RELEASED','CAMPAIGN_RETRY') AND o.state <> 'DONE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM business_outbox WHERE kind IN ('CAMPAIGN_FULFILL','CAMPAIGN_RETRY') AND state <> 'DONE'
SELECT MIN(next_attempt_at) FROM business_outbox WHERE state = 'PENDING'
SELECT id, kind, state, attempts, consume_attempts, created_at, sent_at, consumed_at FROM business_outbox WHERE aggregate_id = #{orderId} AND kind LIKE 'ORDER\_%' ORDER BY id
